name: StartGame
note: Sets TGameState ChocolateFactoryTime="restart", RecycleCount=0; ResetGame; starts 10 ms window animation; SetGameState(1); ResumeGame. Also called by ui/chocolate_gameover.lua try_again. Name shared with CoffeeFactory (last constructed wins; not cleared by the destructor)

name: PauseGame
note: Always resets cursor to cursor/cursor. If not paused: pauses sound and all tasks, stops animation, shows Go/hides Pause, sets global gPauseText=textKey and loads ui/game_pause.lua into the sibling "information" window. Missing arg = "" (game_pause.lua then uses game_paused). Ends with SetTopModalOnly(false)

name: ResumeGame
note: Cursor cursor/gun_aimer hotspot (16,16). If paused: unpause sound, ChocolateFactoryTime=1, hide Go/show Pause, hide information, Restart all tasks, restart 10 ms animation, re-run SetGameState(state), clear paused. Ends with SetTopModalOnly(true)

name: GetScore
note: Cases counted so far (events 0x3ef and 0x3ee). The only value the game reports; ui/chocolate_gameover.lua passes it to CloseWindow

name: ChocolateFactory
note: Registered with AddWindowType. Keys below. Lua-created child Texts named score and countdown (time optional, absent in shipped Lua). Siblings go/pause/information found via parent

name: ChocolateFactory::Init
note: Reseeds global RNG with TPlatform::Timer, builds conveyor, product belt, trays, machinery sprites, gun, rings, recycler, timer; ends with PauseGame("game_paused")

name: ChocolateFactory::PostChildrenInit
note: Resolves Text children time/countdown/score; centres timer face on score rect (fallback 720,80); ResetGame; SetAlpha(1,true)

name: ChocolateFactory::SetGameState
note: States 0 INIT,1 COUNTDOWN,2 PLAYING,3 ENDING,4 ABORTED,5 OVER. Entry actions per state in chocolate-factory.md 4.2

name: ChocolateFactory::OnTaskAnimate
note: One call = 10 game ms (window animation delay 10, repeat, catch-up on, resync if >1 s behind). Clock, countdown, whistle, hand, task ticks, end conditions

name: ChocolateFactory::ResetGame
note: clock=gameTime+countdownTime, score/bonus/miss=0, state=1, all tasks Reset(1.0), PauseGame("game_paused"), clears missed sprites, hides Go and Pause

name: ChocolateFactory::MissedIngredient
note: Parks sprite in divot missed[missCount] at scale 0.6; 8th miss -> state 4; else tray scale *=0.5 (min 1); sound ingredient_failure_N; tutorial pause choco_first_missed

name: ChocolateFactory::OnMessage
note: Handles 0x3e9,0x3eb,0x3ec,0x3ed,0x3ee,0x3ef,0x3f0,0x3f1 (see message rows)

name: ChocolateFactory::OnMouseMove
note: Gun rotation = acos(dy of normalized mouse-gun vector), negated if dx>0, plus pi

name: ChocolateFactory::OnMouseDown
note: Only when state==2: ChocolateGunTask::Fire(point)

name: ChocolateFactory::OnKeyDown
note: Escape pauses with game_paused if not paused; with kCheatMode config and flag bit0 also DoModal('dev/dev_menu.lua')

name: ChocolateFactory::PauseGame
note: See PauseGame global

name: ChocolateFactory::ToggleForeground
note: App activate/deactivate hook: pauses the instance with game_paused

name: ChocolateFactory::Draw
note: Window children then base sprite tree at identity inside TBegin2d

name: ChocolateFactory::ParseRecipe
note: productName, productCode strings; recipe table values as strings in table order

name: dsl:productName
note: Stored only

name: dsl:productCode
note: Stored only

name: dsl:recipe
note: One entry per ingredient instance; size = number of tray slots and selects image/tray<N> (N 2..6)

name: dsl:appearance
note: {code=..} -> items/<code>_big; list of names or {name,r,g,b} -> custom/<name> tinted (+ _highlight layer if present)

name: dsl:machine
note: Sprite layer 6 at (695,301)

name: dsl:warntime
note: Lua: 10000; whistle once when clock crosses it

name: dsl:warnOnMiss
note: Lua: Player.rank<=1 and product.code=="b01"

name: dsl:conveyortime
note: Time for train head to traverse the conveyor curve at scale 1

name: dsl:conveyorcount
note: Slots; spacing=1/count; refill cooldown = conveyortime/count

name: dsl:conveyorpath
note: Gun sits at its end point

name: dsl:colorcount
note: Colours 1..colorcount assigned to queue ingredients when >1

name: dsl:rainbow
note: Allows colour 0 (wild) ingredients; no shipped award sets it

name: dsl:producttime
note: Belt travel time of finished goods

name: dsl:productpath
note: Box sprites placed at its end point

name: dsl:speedup
note: Tray speed multiplier per completed tray; Lua never passes it

name: dsl:maxspeed
note: Tray speed cap; Lua never passes it

name: dsl:traytime
note: One lap at scale 1

name: dsl:trayend
note: Tray delivery point (curve parameter); Lua never passes it

name: dsl:traycount
note: Lua never passes it, so 5 trays (categories.lua traycount=7 is unused)

name: dsl:traypath
note: Trays at phase offset i/traycount

name: dsl:gunspeed
note: Flight time of a shot over 1000 px

name: dsl:ringspeed
note: Flight time of a bonus ring

name: dsl:missed
note: Divot slots; count = misses that end the game (8)

name: dsl:recycler
note: Needs recyclerpath

name: dsl:recyclerpath
note: Bin path

name: dsl:recyclertime
note: Bin lap time

name: IngredientQueue::IngredientQueue
args: (recipe, uint8 colorCount, curve, uint count, baseSprite)
note: spacing=1/count; head=0

name: IngredientQueue::FillQueue
note: 5 copies of each recipe entry, colour RandRange(rainbow?0:1,colorCount) if colorCount>1, naive swap shuffle, consumed from vector back

name: IngredientQueue::Update
note: head=min(1,head+dt); place list at head-k*spacing; spawn while remainder>0; pistons follow

name: IngredientQueue::PopConveyor
note: Returns front only if head==1.0 exactly; then head-=spacing

name: IngredientQueue::PeekConveyor
note: Front or null

name: IngredientQueueTask::Animate
note: Update(AnimateDelta(conveyortime))

name: ChocolateGunTask::Fire
note: Pop conveyor (null -> false); direction normalize*1000; FlyingIngredient start=gun pos; plays gun DoAnim; posts sound launch (0x3ea)

name: ChocolateGunTask::Animate
note: dt=AnimateDelta(gunspeed); per shot: segment-vs-tray circle (radius+16), recycler point test (radius+16), HitTray/HitRecycler, Die at t==1

name: FlyingIngredient::Tick
note: t+=dt clamp 1; pos=start+direction*t; returns t (distance is 0)

name: Ingredient::Die
note: Sends MissedIngredientMessage (0x3eb) to top-modal child "FactoryGame"

name: Ingredient::HitTray
note: tray.AddIngredient(self)

name: Ingredient::HitRecycler
note: recycler.AddIngredient(self)

name: Ingredient::SetColor
note: Ring child image/item_ring (rainbow texture for 0), tint kFactoryColors[c]

name: ChocolateTray::CanAccept
note: True if a slot i with recipe[i]==name is empty (colour ignored)

name: ChocolateTray::AddIngredient
note: First matching empty slot; colour rules; full tray sends 0x3f0, and for colour match 0x3f1+0x3ed + immediate Clear; posts sound names

name: ChocolateTray::Update
note: phase=frac(t+offset); curve position; when crossing endpoint with fillCount==N sends 0x3ec to FactoryGame and Clear(true)

name: ChocolateTray::Clear
note: Empties slots, fillCount=0, colour 0, hides ring, powerup DoAnim, radius 75, identity matrix

name: ChocolateTray::SetColor
note: Recolours slot ingredients, ring tint/visibility (hidden for 0)

name: ChocolateTray::Scale
note: radius*=f and matrix scale (only used by unreachable EnlargeIngredient)

name: ChocolateTrayTask::Animate
note: Animate; T=GetT(traytime); update trays; if all trays full: sound ingredient_complete_full_bonus, Clear all, 0x3ed per tray

name: ChocolateTrayTask::AnyFull
note: True if any tray has fillCount==N

name: ChocolateProductQueueTask::AddProduct
note: New ChocolateProduct at curve start; BuildItemAppearance scale 0.5

name: ChocolateProductQueueTask::Animate
note: t+=AnimateDelta(producttime); at t>=1 send 0x3ef to FactoryGame, post sound chocolate_counted, erase; stops loop at first product with t<0.1

name: Recycler::AddIngredient
note: DoAnim, remove sprite, sound recycler, TGameState "++RecycleCount"

name: Recycler::Update
note: Position on recycler curve at frac(t)

name: Recycler::CanAccept
note: Always true; radius 72

name: FlyingRingStartMessage::Initiate
note: One FlyingRing per recipe slot from slot global position to target; ChocolateFactory passes (689,555)

name: FlyingRing::Update
note: t+=dt clamp 1; false at arrival

name: FlyingRingTask::Animate
note: dt=AnimateDelta(ringspeed); on arrival sends 0x3ee to FactoryGame and erases

name: TScalingTask::Tick/Animate/Reset/Restart/Pause/AnimateDelta
note: time += (taskClock-lastClock)*scale; AnimateDelta = phase delta over one period

name: TCurve::GetPoint
note: Arc-length parameterised cubic Bezier chain; flatten tolerance 0.2 (_ACCEPTABLE_ERROR); t<=0 start, t>=1 end point index ((n-1)/3)*3

name: LoadAppearance
note: See md 3.4

name: BuildItemAppearance
note: Layer sprites + optional _highlight

name: msg:0x3e9 kAppDeactivate
note: Pause with game_paused

name: msg:0x3ea kSoundEvent
note: Forwarded to BSGSoundEvent(name); posted via PostWindowMessage

name: msg:0x3eb kMissedIngredientEvent
note: Sent to FactoryGame by Ingredient::Die

name: msg:0x3ec kManufactureProductEvent
note: machineTime=1 if 0, sound snatch, then (fall-through, inference) same as 0x3ed. Sent by a full tray crossing its end point

name: msg:0x3ed kProduceProductEvent
note: AddProduct to belt

name: msg:0x3ee kCountBonusProductEvent
note: bonusScore+=1 then score+=1 (from rings)

name: msg:0x3ef kCountProductEvent
note: score+=1; score Text "%lu"; sent when a product reaches belt end

name: msg:0x3f0 kFillTrayEvent
note: tray scale*=speedup, capped at maxspeed; sent to top modal on tray full (reaches factory as modal default focus)

name: msg:0x3f1 kColorMatchEvent
note: Initiate rings to (689,555)
